label: first copy-phase input is r/y/h/d/1/x (echoed first token), longer sequences
explanation: Copy-phase-only unit (essentially 0 activations in original/delimiter phases). 86% of activation mass is at step L+1 (recall_idx 1), where the input is the fed-back first original token; another 13% is at recall_idx 2. It strongly prefers specific input tokens: r, y, h, d, 1, x (rates 3-7x lift; f/l/p/k/s/a are much weaker). Magnitude grows with sequence length (L=9 holds 43% of mass, L<=4 almost nothing; to_go 6-7 is highest), and top activations are all r/y/d/x at step L+1 in L=8-9 sequences. It never fires on first occurrences of a token or before <DEL>. Predicate (recall_idx==1, in_tok in {r,y,h,d,1,x}, L>=6) reaches dev F1 0.63 / mass recall 0.76; misses are mostly weaker activations at recall_idx 2 or with other tokens/short L, and about a third of predicted steps are inactive, with no simple further token condition found.
